 Asset Description : 
 A medium voltage motor (15Kv), with a vertical orientation, solid shaft, and tilt pad ball guide, is a type of industrial motor designed for continuous operation in demanding environments. It features a lubrication system that utilizes both oil and grease for the bearings, as well as a thrust bearing with oil cooling water coils to prevent overheating. The motor also includes an anti-rotation device to ensure stable and reliable operation. The main components of this motor include:

1. Stator: The stationary part of the motor that contains the windings which produce the magnetic field.
2. Rotor: The rotating part of the motor, connected to the shaft.
3. Shaft: A long, solid piece of metal that transmits the torque from the rotor to the load.
4. Tilt Pad Ball Guide Bearings: A specific type of bearing that uses a tilting pad to distribute the load evenly and reduce wear.
5. Lubrication System: Includes oil and grease for the bearings, as well as a thrust bearing with oil cooling water coils to prevent overheating.
6. Anti-Rotation Device: Prevents the rotor from rotating around its own axis, ensuring stable and reliable operation.
7. Windings: The coils of wire on the stator that, when energized, produce a magnetic field that interacts with the rotor to produce torque.
8. Terminal Box: A protective enclosure for the electrical connections to the motor.
9. Fan: A device used to cool the motor by blowing air across the windings.
10. Nameplate: A plate attached to the motor that provides important information such as the model number, voltage, and horsepower.
11. Grounding Strap: A conductive strap used to ground the motor, providing protection against electrical shock and reducing the risk of damage to the motor.
12. Base: The mounting surface for the motor, typically a steel or cast iron plate that provides support and stability.
13. Ventilation: Holes or openings in the motor casing that allow air to flow through and cool the motor.
